title: Protection Cover Met Against What an Equipment Rental and Demo Agreement Still Owes
content:
A Pass and Trip Protection plan written over a rental agreement carries a benefit limit that claims draw down, and what is left of that limit meets what the agreement still owes.

## The rule

Where the household holds a Pass and Trip Protection plan standing active written over the agreement, whose cover left is at or above what the agreement still owes, the whole of what it still owes is met by that plan.

Where the household holds a Pass and Trip Protection plan standing active written over the agreement, whose cover left is below what the agreement still owes, the cover left on it is met by that plan.

In any other case nothing is met by a protection plan under this heading.

## The branches

| Protection plan standing active written over the agreement | Its cover left against what the agreement still owes | Met by the plan |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | at or above it | the whole of what the agreement still owes |
| yes | below it | the cover left on the plan |
| no such plan | — | nothing under this heading |

Cover left standing at exactly what the agreement still owes falls in the first row, and the whole of what is owed is met.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical agreement

Take an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement that still owes 220.25 USD.

- A protection plan stands active over that agreement with 500.00 USD of cover left: the whole 220.25 USD is met by the plan.
- A protection plan stands active over that agreement with 150.00 USD of cover left: 150.00 USD is met by the plan.
- A protection plan stands active over that agreement with 220.25 USD of cover left: the whole 220.25 USD is met by the plan.
- No protection plan stands active over that agreement: nothing is met under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**Which plan is read.** The plan read is one standing active and written over that rental agreement itself. A protection plan the household holds over some other holding is not written over this agreement and does not meet anything under this heading.
